normative_validation.reason: The obtainable roc-validator 0.11.3 supplies RO-Crate 1.1 and 1.2 profiles, not RO-Crate 1.3. A 1.2 result cannot demonstrate conformance to the pinned 1.3 base.

validator_discovery.installation: temporary virtual environment; not a repository dependency
validator_discovery.correction: The session-13 claim that no validator was obtainable was false. Installation succeeds; support for the normative version is what is unavailable.

json_ld_parse.scope: JSON-LD parsing only; not RO-Crate conformance

non_normative_1_2_export.method: Temporary export changed only the context URI and metadata-descriptor conformsTo value from 1.3 to 1.2; provider bytes were neither required nor retained; validator ran with --metadata-only and --skip-availability-check.
non_normative_1_2_export.warning: This compatibility result is not a validation of the normative 1.3 manifests.
non_normative_1_2_export.interpretation: The dominant 1.2 failure is the validator's compact-context check over provisional ftro:* keys. Optical also triggers base rules for its two unresolved software entities; GNSS triggers one URI-string/reference rule. These are amendment inputs, not a substitute 1.3 verdict.

bounded_gate1_check.scope: Exact frozen source identity, captured-input integrity, selected report-to-manifest projections, flattened named entities, fixed JSON-LD context, root/profile/conformance-report structure, local references and minimum unresolved-assertion structure. It is explicitly not a general RO-Crate or FTRO-profile validator.

conclusion: Gate 1 source location is demonstrated. RO-Crate 1.3 conformance is still not demonstrated and remains an open Phase-1 assurance gap.
